result.reason: The redline appropriately makes the cap mutual and changes it to the greater of trailing 12-month amounts and USD 1,000,000. However, the supplied operative language does not establish the required mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, the required uncapped carve-outs, or that Customer payment obligations are not damages. “Excluded Claims” is undefined in the supplied text, and the margin comment cannot supply missing operative terms; moreover, it mentions only indemnification and confidentiality/data-protection carve-outs, not all required preferred carve-outs or even the fallback carve-outs for gross negligence and wilful misconduct. The amendment is narrowly drafted and generally preserves unrelated intent, but it does not reach either playbook position.
